meta.description: Registry for bounded orientation-sensitive tie-resolution behavior under exact degenerate minima and local selection competition in Phase 3.

degenerate_tiebreak_entries.name: Degenerate Minima Tiebreak Dynamics
degenerate_tiebreak_entries.purpose: Represent bounded orientation-sensitive tie-resolution behavior under exact degenerate minima and local selection competition.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: exact_degenerate_minima_remain_detectable
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: The system must maintain formal predicates to identify when multiple candidates satisfy extremal selection metrics identically.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_tiebreak_dynamics_remain_defined
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: Formal support for using secondary orientation frame properties to differentiate between tied minima.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: local_selection_competition_remains_admissible
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: The process of competing between tied candidates must respect current admissibility windows.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: tie_resolution_does_not_force_global_uniqueness
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: Resolving a local tie does not imply the elimination of all other valid continuation paths.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: recursive_tiebreak_updates_remain_bounded
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: Iterative application of tie-breaking rules must not result in divergent frame or state drift.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_degenerate_witness
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: Pruning of unselected tied candidates must not eliminate all admissible continuations.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: multi_branch_minima_competition_remains_classifiable
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: The interaction between competing tied branches must map to registered transition or stability classes.

degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.name: degenerate_tiebreak_instability_remains_detectable
degenerate_tiebreak_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of tie-resolution stability.
